profile.subline: IT-audit and technology-risk roles for an April 2027 accounting graduate · Tailored to your resume
profile.recentRole: KPMG — Technology Risk Intern, Salt Lake City (Summer 2026)
profile.stack: Audit, SOX testing, Alteryx, ACL, Excel, information-systems minor, CPA-track
profile.target: IT audit or technology-risk associate · Salt Lake City · Big Four or bank
profile.summary: An accounting degree with an IS minor and two Big Four internships is the exact profile the technology-assurance classes on this board recruit. You graduate in April, so programs that want a December 2026 finish are the wrong cohort; most summer/fall 2027 classes fit.

searchLinks.label: IT audit associate, Salt Lake City

profile.applyNow: Deloitte's Technology Controls Advisory, KPMG Technology Assurance, PwC's DAT Data class and Goldman's Internal Audit analyst seat are the live doors; Zions' GRC analyst is the local one.
profile.watchLater: Wells Fargo's Audit Analyst Development Program reposts in the spring.
